citation.authors: Whelehan G, West S, Abdelrahman DR, Murton AJ, Finnigan TJA, Wall BT, Stephens FB
citation.title: The addition of mycoprotein to a mixed-meal impacts postprandial glucose kinetics without altering blood glucose concentrations: a randomised controlled trial

population.description: 24 adults, 8 women and 16 men (Table 1). Age 30.1 (SD 8.4) y at screening and BMI 30.5 (SD 5.7) kg/m2, both Table 1 mean (SD); BMI range 22.2-38.5 is the observed range printed in the Discussion. The paper never calls the group healthy and reports no glucose test at screening (the Discussion notes the 2 h glucose was below 6 mmol/L in all but one, after recruitment), so status is unselected.

protocols.name: fasted_morning
protocols.description: Overnight fast of 10 h, water only (Methods: arrival at 0700 +/- 1 h following a 10 h overnight fast); a 30-minute arm with no food. Table 1 fasting glucose and insulin are entered as the fasted morning value, read at minutes 29-30; the paper prints no sampling time or visit for Table 1 (its age is 'at screening').

protocols.name: control_drink
protocols.description: 250 mL full-fat milk with 50 g dextrose and no mycoprotein (CON), drunk within 5 min at the paper's t = 0, which is arm minute 120; arm minute 0 is the priming dose at t = -120 min. Carbohydrate 74.5 g, protein 17.8 g, fat 11.9 g, fibre 0.2 g as printed in Table 2; carbohydrate is taken as printed and excludes fibre because 4 x 74.5 + 4 x 17.8 + 9 x 11.9 = 476.3 kcal, the printed CON energy. Fat types from Table 2 (7.7 + 3.2 + 1.0 = 11.9 g). Samples t = -30 to 360 min, arm minutes 90 to 480.

protocols.name: mycoprotein_drink
protocols.description: 250 mL full-fat milk with 50 g dextrose and 20 g mycoprotein (MYC), drunk within 5 min at the paper's t = 0, which is arm minute 120; arm minute 0 is the priming dose at t = -120 min. Carbohydrate 74.5 g, protein 17.8 g, fat 11.9 g and fibre 5.0 g as printed in Table 2; carbohydrate excludes fibre as for CON (4 x 74.5 + 4 x 17.8 + 9 x 11.9 = 476.3 kcal against the printed 475.8). Fat types from Table 2 (6.6 + 2.9 + 2.2 = 11.7 g, under the printed 11.9 g). Samples t = -30 to 360 min, arm minutes 90 to 480.

meals.food: milk drink with 50 g dextrose and 20 g mycoprotein

findings.description: Fasting plasma glucose, mean (SD), all 24 participants (Table 1), entered on a fasted morning

location.where: Table 1, row 'Fasting Insulin'; table caption 'Data presented as mean (SD)'

findings.description: Serum insulin peak over the 6 h after the control drink, read as the mean of the participants' own peaks. The paper prints 'peak' without defining it; it analyses it as a summary measure by repeated-measures ANOVA, and the same paragraph's 'mean peak blood glucose of 7.3 mmol/L at 41 min' is at a time that is not a sampling minute (samples every 15 min to t = 120), so these are per-person peaks, not the peak of the mean curve.

location.where: Results, 'Postprandial glucose and insulin response' (insulin paragraph); methods: 'Data are presented as mean (SEM) unless otherwise stated'
location.quote: MYC had a greater peak of 722 (59) compared to 667 (66) pmol٠L−1 after CON ingestion (P = 0.02).

left_out.what: glucose AUC 0-6 h, 1804 (42) CON and 1778 (36) MYC, and 0-2 h, 720 (29) and 712 (25), printed as 'mmol/L x 6 h' and 'mmol/L x 2 h' (Results, glucose paragraph; mean (SEM) by the Methods): read in hours these would be mean concentrations of 300 and 360 mmol/L; the paper prints no minute unit, and the guide says a unit that contradicts the numbers is left out, not corrected
mean peak blood glucose 7.3 mmol/L at 41 min, both drinks (Results, glucose paragraph): no uncertainty printed
blood glucose and serum insulin time courses over 6 h (Figure 1A and C): figure only

total glucose appearance (RaT) over 6 h, 90 (12) g CON and 95 (13) g MYC (Results, plasma glucose kinetics): this is the tracer-derived total rate of appearance, which includes endogenous glucose production (exogenous glucose was 62 and 60% of it), not the drink's glucose alone; the 0-120 min part, 46 and 51 g, is printed without uncertainty; the model has no total-appearance marker

exogenous (oral) glucose appearing in the circulation over 6 h, 53 g for both drinks, in the 13C-tracer subset of 12 (Results, plasma glucose kinetics): no uncertainty printed, and the model has no oral glucose appearance marker
total glucose disappearance as grams, 0-120 min 42 (9) and 47 (9) g and 6 h 93 and 99 g (Results, RdT paragraph; the 6 h totals have no uncertainty): grams in total, not a rate per kg of body weight
RaT, RdT, RaEx and EGP rate time courses over 6 h (Figure 2A, C, E, G): figure only
carbohydrate oxidation over 6 h, 62 (21) g CON and 58 (20) g MYC (Results, substrate oxidation paragraph)
fat oxidation over 6 h, 24 (9) g CON and 24 (9) g MYC (Results, substrate oxidation paragraph)
total energy expenditure over 6 h, 1920 (292) kJ CON and 1904 (378) kJ MYC (Results, substrate oxidation paragraph): a total over the arm, not a rate; the rate curves are Figure 3A only
insulin sensitivity indices, Table 3 (insulinogenic index, Matsuda, Cederholm, disposition index), CON and MYC with SD
percent changes with MYC: RaT over 6 h +5% (P = 0.03), mean 6 h glucose appearance and disappearance +5% and +9% (Abstract), RdT over 6 h +7%, EGP share of appearance 15% greater (P = 0.05)
